title: A criterion for the well-posedness of McKean-Vlasov stochastic differential equations
summary: We establish strong existence and pathwise uniqueness for McKean-Vlasov stochastic differential equations with coefficients satisfying a distribution-dependent Lyapunov condition. Under a hybrid Perron-Nagumo condition that permits a non-integrable singularity at the initial time, pathwise uniqueness holds within the class of strong solutions satisfying the corresponding Lyapunov estimate.
